fatal_errors: The proposed copper system does not address the target comparison between NbMoTaW and Re-containing NbMoTaWRe refractory high-entropy-alloy films.
It omits helium implantation, irradiation-induced hardening, helium-bubble segregation, and grain-boundary embrittlement.
The pure-iron baseline and claimed 20% elongation increase are unsupported and unrelated to the target baseline.
explanation: The hypothesis gives a generic, qualitatively plausible reason for annealed copper ductility—accessible slip and dislocation glide—but it does not reconstruct the target material, intervention, mechanism, or outcome. Room-temperature testing is the only meaningful condition overlap. Dislocation climb is also not generally the dominant room-temperature deformation mechanism in copper. The proposed tensile comparison is falsifiable, but its materials, boundary, and numerical threshold are arbitrary and unsuitable for distinguishing the irradiation response of the thin-film refractory alloys in the target study.
